page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 152 at left. One column of running text at right of centre; left margin empty except faint show-through. Catchword/signature line at foot: "næ" at right, with a faint "Liber" fragment (show-through, not transcribed).

main_text.p: fibile : Esse hîc totum, esse totum alibi ; Maius esse hîc, minus illic ; Esse vnum & plura ; πᾶν τὸ ἓν ἐν πεῖον, recedere non recedere, cœlo capi, non capi cœlo ; Esse quantum absque spatio, commensurari & adæquari loco, locum non occupare ; Accidentia esse & non inhærere ; Esse & tamen fieri, fieri & non fieri ; Aliter esse in locis, quàm in loco ; Esse ὅλως ὅλον, & tamen corpus : Esse verum corpus, & esse spiritualiter ad modum Dei, vapulet (me quidem censore) quisquis puerorum, contradictoria non agnouerit : Sed quid ego spinosioribus hisce immoror ? Sce-næ

page.notes: Greek words in the text are transcribed approximately from a small, blurred scan; the Greek phrase "πᾶν τὸ ἓν ἐν πεῖον" and "ὅλως ὅλον" are uncertain [?]. Catchword "næ" and the faint foot line are read with doubt. Left margin is blank apart from show-through and was not transcribed.
